scope: development training-role worlds and previously preregistered WT training-only stability bound; no v6 scoring result or runner scoring seed access
application: Each threshold applies separately in every evaluator-private family and K cell; no averaging can rescue a failed cell.

learner_contract.base_prediction: mechanical persistence from history coordinates not present in future_public mask
learner_contract.learned_quantity: one affine next-state predictor whose correction relative to persistence is clipped coordinatewise to +/-4 standardized units
learner_contract.fit: ridge-0.001 sufficient statistics over assigned anonymous support_input/support_target pairs
learner_contract.adapt: add only the current test world's public support pairs to a session-local copy of sufficient statistics
learner_contract.rollout: recursive 50-step prediction with evaluator-public future coordinates and predicted state
learner_contract.source_identity: one implementation, constants and update law for shared, independent, cross-family-only and support-only roles
learner_contract.permutation_equivariance: consistent permutation of anonymous input coordinates and corresponding output/state coordinates commutes with fit, adapt and predict

forbidden_inputs: semantic channel names or handwritten ontology
v6 runner scoring seed or score
